architecture_doc62_SS7.intro: U_L(theta) = RY(theta) . V_{L-1} . RY(theta) . ... . V_1 . RY(theta) per referent wire, EVERY upload carrying the SAME angle theta (kappa = 1 FIXED)
architecture_doc62_SS7.V_j: Circuit4(1, 3) -- the COMMITTED ansatz at one qubit, RX.RZ three times, 6 parameters, CRX cascade EMPTY by construction. NO NEW ANSATZ (doc 55 SS4.7).
architecture_doc62_SS7.sharing: ONE parameter set per layer index j, applied to EVERY referent wire (doc 62 SS7.2): the wire index is an arbitrary compiler-assigned referent slot, not a semantic role.
architecture_doc62_SS7.everything_else: the committed recipe UNCHANGED (doc 62 SS6.2): same dataset, splits, FA angle features, six verb blocks, readout, 150 epochs, lr 0.02, Adam, batch 8, selection rule, n_test = 300. THE ONLY CHANGE IS THE INTRO.

advantage_prohibition: NO EXP75 NUMBER MAY APPEAR IN A SENTENCE CONTAINING 'ADVANTAGE' (doc 52 SS1; doc 56 SS0.1; doc 58 SS12; doc 61 SS0.3; doc 62 SS0.3 / SS16). The model's output is a degree-L TRIGONOMETRIC POLYNOMIAL in two scalars and the function-class reference is a LINEAR MODEL on the joint harmonic features -- 25 numbers at L = 2, 49 at L = 3.
scope_doc62_SS16: NO QUANTUM READING OF ANY KIND.

NOT A STATEMENT ABOUT DATA RE-UPLOADING IN GENERAL: exp75 runs FIXED UNIT PREFACTORS, L in {2, 3}, one-qubit interleave blocks from the committed ansatz, on ONE scalar feature per referent, two referents, two events, one category, one surface, 24 nouns, in simulation. The TRAINABLE-PREFACTOR variant is explicitly DECLINED (SS4.3, SS17 items 1-2) and no exp75 outcome speaks to it.

NOT A STATEMENT ABOUT UNIVERSALITY: universality is an ASYMPTOTIC statement about arbitrarily many uploads and arbitrary trainable processing; L <= 3 with 6-12 interleave parameters is not that, and no null here contradicts Perez-Salinas et al. or Schuld et al.
NOT A STATEMENT ABOUT BARREN PLATEAUS -- 2-wire circuits.

NOT A CLAIM ABOUT THE DEGREE-L FUNCTION CLASS even if a cell beats tier (ii): the comparator is a SUPERSET IN COEFFICIENT SPACE and a RESTRICTION ACROSS CONDITIONING GROUPS (SS10.4), and both qualifiers travel together.
NOT A REPAIR OF E4's VERDICT: E4 produced NO verdict. Nothing here retro-validates `results_exp60.json`'s `reuploading_relieves = FALSE`, which remains INADMISSIBLE (doc 46 SS10.5).
ONE DATASET, ONE TASK FAMILY, TWO REFERENTS, TWO EVENTS, 5 SEEDS.
